# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 07, Serye ng 2023 — Municipal Market Code of Pitogo

## Summary

This ordinance enacts a comprehensive Municipal Market Code for [[Pitogo, Quezon]], establishing fees, regulations, and operational guidelines for the municipal market. It references [[Sec-129-RA7160]] on LGU revenue powers and [[Sec-143-RA7160]] on tax on business. The Market Code covers market stall allocation, fees collection, sanitation requirements, and vendor regulations. It works in tandem with [[MO-01-S2023]], which recognized the Trading Post as the official Municipal Market.

## Key Provisions

- Establishes a comprehensive regulatory framework for the municipal market (Market Code).
- Prescribes market stall allocation procedures and criteria for vendors.
- Sets fee schedules for market stalls, permits, and other market-related charges.
- Mandates sanitation requirements and cleanliness standards for market areas.
- Regulates vendor conduct, operating hours, and commercial activities within the market.
- References [[Sec-129-RA7160]] on LGU taxation powers over sand, gravel, and quarry resources.
- References [[Sec-143-RA7160]] on the tax on business as basis for market fees.
